title: Rows and peer frames
brief: Distinguish physical-row frames from equal-date peer frames.
instructions: Return every event. ROWS running total orders by date then identity; RANGE running total orders by date alone. Return both exact totals.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes event_id,event_date,amount from daily_events without solving rows and peer frames.

hints.text: ROWS advances one ordered row; RANGE includes equal-date peers.
Use a deterministic date-and-identity ordering only for the ROWS expression.
